svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 739 mm lengths of DN25 (33.7 mm outside) galvanized

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steel pipe; square both ends with a file and deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No threads and no holes: the flange grips the pipe with its set

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws and the U-bolts clamp it at the mast.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the cut ends with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one end goes 45 mm into the flange hub (to its stop) and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set screws are tightened; the pipe then runs past the mast, which

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it passes 6 mm to the side of, and ends 50 mm beyond the mast's line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit a plastic end cap on the outer end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: length 739 mm within 2 mm; both ends square.
